topic.title: Are Cloud-Based AI Coding Assistants Permitted for Private Competition Code?

messages.content: Yes - coding assistants are permitted for use in this competition.
messages.rawMarkdown: Yes - coding assistants are permitted for use in this competition.

messages.content: Are participants permitted to use cloud-based coding assistants such as Codex, ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude on their privately developed competition code, provided Competition Data and Pokémon assets are not included? Are additional privacy or data-retention settings required?
